text: DSH Plugin Scaffold 是一个面向 web 客户端的 DSH 插件脚手架，提供兼容性检查、宿主服务入口和浏览器客户端锚点。bundle 将兼容门禁、宿主服务与客户端入口分别挂载；当前服务只暴露兼容版本，客户端 apply 为空，适合用作新插件的派生起点。使用时需匹配代码列出的 DSH 版本。

DSH Plugin Scaffold is a web DSH plugin starter with a compatibility gate, host service, and browser entry. Its bundle mounts these parts separately. The service exposes the supported release, while the client apply is empty. Use it as a starting point with a listed DSH version.
我想从一个带版本兼容检查的 DSH 插件骨架开始开发。
I need a starter structure for a DSH plugin with separate host and browser entry points.
DSH Plugin Scaffold 的功能「兼容性启动门禁」：启动时按精确版本契约判断当前 DSH 安装，并提供兼容性服务供其他 bundle 行依赖。
DSH Plugin Scaffold 的功能「宿主与浏览器入口骨架」：bundle 分别挂载宿主服务入口和 web 客户端入口；当前客户端 apply 不注册界面贡献，供开发者替换扩展。

@dsh-electron/dsh-plugin-scaffold README · 项目简介：这是一个最小的 **out-of-tree DSH（DeepSeek Harness）插件脚手架**。它不修改上游任何包，把搭一个 DSH 插件真正需要、却很容易搭错的部分先准备好：

- **bundle 骨架**：兼容性门禁行、宿主服务行、浏览器 client 图锚点行，三行各司其职；
- **host/client 分半构建**：tsdown 产出宿主 ESM 与浏览器闭包工厂，tsc 产出两套声明；
- **兼容性代码契约**：精确版本 allowlist、`unsupported` / `mixed` / `incomplete` 判定、升级车道；
- **完整验证链**：类型检查、lint、单测、组合冒烟、打包门禁、文档检查；
- **工程约定**：AGENTS.md、`.agent/`、`docs/` 九分区、双语 README/CHANGELOG、CI/release/upgrade/diag 工作流。
@dsh-electron/dsh-plugin-scaffold README · 项目简介：脚手架当前只提供**可运行的骨架**：`src/service.ts` 暴露一个占位服务，`src/client/index.ts` 的 `apply` 为空。把这里替换成你的插件行为即可，其余基础设施不需要重搭。

@dsh-electron/dsh-plugin-scaffold README · 环境要求：**作为插件使用者**：一个下表中的 DSH 版本（精确匹配，不是范围）。`dsh plugin` 负责安装，无需本地 Node 工具链。

| DSH 系列 | 受支持的版本 |
| --- | --- |
| `0.2.1` | `0.2.1-rc.2` |

**从源码开发**：Node.js `^22.19.0 || >=24`，pnpm `11.25.0`（建议经 corepack 启用）；开发 pin 的 DSH 为 `0.2.1-rc.2`。

@dsh-electron/dsh-plugin-scaffold README · 快速开始：```sh
git clone https://github.com/cherrchen/dsh-plugin-scaffold.git my-dsh-plugin
cd my-dsh-plugin
export CI=true
pnpm install

`pnpm verify:all` 会依次跑 lint、typecheck、build、test、组合冒烟、打包门禁与打包冒烟。首次运行需要能访问 npm registry。

| --- | --- | --- |
| `package.json` `name` | `@dsh-electron/dsh-plugin-scaffold` | 你的包名 |
| `package.json` `repository.url` | `git+https://github.com/cherrchen/dsh-plugin-scaffold.git` | 你的仓库地址 |
| `LICENSE` 版权行 | `Copyright (c) 2026 Cherry Chen` | 你的名字或组织 |
| 包名引用（源码/脚本/测试） | `@dsh-electron/dsh-plugin-scaffold` | 你的包名 |
| 环境变量 | `DSH_PLUGIN_SCAFFOLD_COMPAT` | `DSH_<YOUR_PLUGIN>_COMPAT` |
| 兼容性服务键 | `dshPluginScaffoldCompat` | 你的服务键 |
| 宿主服务键 | `dshPluginScaffold` | 你的服务键 |
| Connection 通道 | `/dsh-plugin-scaffold` | 你的通道 |
| patch 行 id | `dsh-plugin-scaffold-compat` / `-service` / `-client` | 你的行 id |
| 文档与计划文件名 | 含 `dsh-plugin-scaffold` 的文件 | 你的文档名 |

@dsh-electron/dsh-plugin-scaffold README · 把它变成你的插件：一次定位所有需要改的地方：

```sh
grep -rn "dsh-plugin-scaffold\|dshPluginScaffold\|DSH_PLUGIN_SCAFFOLD" \
  --exclude-dir=node_modules --exclude-dir=.git --exclude-dir=lib .
```

随后按你的插件实际耦合的包，调整 `src/compat/dsh-version.ts` 里的 `REQUIRED_CORE_PACKAGES`、`OPTIONAL_CORE_PACKAGES` 与 `peerDependencies`；`pnpm compat:check` 会在两处漂移时报错。

@dsh-electron/dsh-plugin-scaffold README · 安装与验证组合：安装进 DSH 运行时并检查组合：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add /path/to/repo
dsh --profile web --dump-config | grep -A4 'dsh-plugin-scaffold'
```

预期输出：

```text

@dsh-electron/dsh-plugin-scaffold README · == @dsh-electron/dsh-plugin-scaffold：- id: dsh-plugin-scaffold-compat
  name: '@dsh-electron/dsh-plugin-scaffold/compat'
- id: dsh-plugin-scaffold-service
  name: '@dsh-electron/dsh-plugin-scaffold/service'
- id: dsh-plugin-scaffold-client
  name: '@dsh-electron/dsh-plugin-scaffold'
```

`dsh-plugin-scaffold-compat` 是启动门禁，`dsh-plugin-scaffold-service` 是宿主服务半部（它 inject `dshPluginScaffoldCompat`，门禁不过即不启动），`dsh-plugin-scaffold-client` 挂在裸包名上，是 web 客户端图读取 `dsh.client` 声明的唯一锚点。

@dsh-electron/dsh-plugin-scaffold README · Overview：The scaffold currently ships a **runnable skeleton**: `src/service.ts` exposes a placeholder service and `src/client/index.ts` has an empty `apply`. Replace those with your plugin's behavior; the rest of the infrastructure does not need rebuilding.

| DSH line | Supported releases |
| --- | --- |
| `0.2.1` | `0.2.1-rc.2` |

**Developing from source**: Node.js `^22.19.0 || >=24`, pnpm `11.25.0` (enable via corepack); the development pin is DSH `0.2.1-rc.2`.

@dsh-electron/dsh-plugin-scaffold README · Quick start：```sh
git clone https://github.com/cherrchen/dsh-plugin-scaffold.git my-dsh-plugin
cd my-dsh-plugin
export CI=true
pnpm install

`pnpm verify:all` runs lint, typecheck, build, tests, the composition smoke, the pack gate, and the packed smoke in order. The first run needs access to the npm registry.

@dsh-electron/dsh-plugin-scaffold README · Turning it into your plugin：Every identifier in the scaffold is concentrated in a small set of names. When deriving a new project, replace the following and rerun `pnpm verify:all`:

| --- | --- | --- |
| `package.json` `name` | `@dsh-electron/dsh-plugin-scaffold` | your package name |
| `package.json` `repository.url` | `git+https://github.com/cherrchen/dsh-plugin-scaffold.git` | your repository URL |
| `LICENSE` copyright line | `Copyright (c) 2026 Cherry Chen` | your name or organization |
| Package-name references (source/scripts/tests) | `@dsh-electron/dsh-plugin-scaffold` | your package name |
| Environment variable | `DSH_PLUGIN_SCAFFOLD_COMPAT` | `DSH_<YOUR_PLUGIN>_COMPAT` |
| Compatibility service key | `dshPluginScaffoldCompat` | your service key |
| Host service key | `dshPluginScaffold` | your service key |
| Connection channel | `/dsh-plugin-scaffold` | your channel |
| Patch row ids | `dsh-plugin-scaffold-compat` / `-service` / `-client` | your row ids |
| Documentation and plan filenames | the files containing `dsh-plugin-scaffold` | your document names |

@dsh-electron/dsh-plugin-scaffold README · Turning it into your plugin：Locate every place that needs changing:

```sh
grep -rn "dsh-plugin-scaffold\|dshPluginScaffold\|DSH_PLUGIN_SCAFFOLD" \
  --exclude-dir=node_modules --exclude-dir=.git --exclude-dir=lib .
```

Then adjust `REQUIRED_CORE_PACKAGES`, `OPTIONAL_CORE_PACKAGES`, and `peerDependencies` in `src/compat/dsh-version.ts` to the packages your plugin actually couples to; `pnpm compat:check` fails when the two drift apart.

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add /path/to/repo
dsh --profile web --dump-config | grep -A4 'dsh-plugin-scaffold'
```

@dsh-electron/dsh-plugin-scaffold README · Overview：The scaffold currently ships a **runnable skeleton**: `src/service.ts` exposes a placeholder service and `src/client/index.ts` has an empty `apply`. Replace those with your plugin's behavior; the rest of the infrastructure does not need rebuilding.

@dsh-electron/dsh-plugin-scaffold README · Requirements：**Using the plugin**: one of the DSH releases below (exact match, not a range). `dsh plugin` handles installation; no local Node toolchain is needed.

| DSH line | Supported releases |
| --- | --- |
| `0.2.1` | `0.2.1-rc.2` |

**Developing from source**: Node.js `^22.19.0 || >=24`, pnpm `11.25.0` (enable via corepack); the development pin is DSH `0.2.1-rc.2`.

@dsh-electron/dsh-plugin-scaffold README · Quick start：```sh
git clone https://github.com/cherrchen/dsh-plugin-scaffold.git my-dsh-plugin
cd my-dsh-plugin
export CI=true
pnpm install

`pnpm verify:all` runs lint, typecheck, build, tests, the composition smoke, the pack gate, and the packed smoke in order. The first run needs access to the npm registry.

@dsh-electron/dsh-plugin-scaffold README · Turning it into your plugin：Every identifier in the scaffold is concentrated in a small set of names. When deriving a new project, replace the following and rerun `pnpm verify:all`:

@dsh-electron/dsh-plugin-scaffold README · Turning it into your plugin：| Location | Current scaffold value | Replace with |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `package.json` `name` | `@dsh-electron/dsh-plugin-scaffold` | your package name |
| `package.json` `repository.url` | `git+https://github.com/cherrchen/dsh-plugin-scaffold.git` | your repository URL |
| `LICENSE` copyright line | `Copyright (c) 2026 Cherry Chen` | your name or organization |
| Package-name references (source/scripts/tests) | `@dsh-electron/dsh-plugin-scaffold` | your package name |
| Environment variable | `DSH_PLUGIN_SCAFFOLD_COMPAT` | `DSH_<YOUR_PLUGIN>_COMPAT` |
| Compatibility service key | `dshPluginScaffoldCompat` | your service key |
| Host service key | `dshPluginScaffold` | your service key |
| Connection channel | `/dsh-plugin-scaffold` | your channel |
| Patch row ids | `dsh-plugin-scaffold-compat` / `-service` / `-client` | your row ids |
| Documentation and plan filenames | the files containing `dsh-plugin-scaffold` | your document names |

@dsh-electron/dsh-plugin-scaffold README · Turning it into your plugin：Locate every place that needs changing:

```sh
grep -rn "dsh-plugin-scaffold\|dshPluginScaffold\|DSH_PLUGIN_SCAFFOLD" \
  --exclude-dir=node_modules --exclude-dir=.git --exclude-dir=lib .
```

Then adjust `REQUIRED_CORE_PACKAGES`, `OPTIONAL_CORE_PACKAGES`, and `peerDependencies` in `src/compat/dsh-version.ts` to the packages your plugin actually couples to; `pnpm compat:check` fails when the two drift apart.

@dsh-electron/dsh-plugin-scaffold README · Install and verify the composition：Install into a DSH runtime and inspect the composition:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add /path/to/repo
dsh --profile web --dump-config | grep -A4 'dsh-plugin-scaffold'
```

Expected output:

```text

  name: '@dsh-electron/dsh-plugin-scaffold/compat'
- id: dsh-plugin-scaffold-service
  name: '@dsh-electron/dsh-plugin-scaffold/service'

  name: '@dsh-electron/dsh-plugin-scaffold'
```

@dsh-electron/dsh-plugin-scaffold README · 项目简介：这是一个最小的 **out-of-tree DSH（DeepSeek Harness）插件脚手架**。它不修改上游任何包，把搭一个 DSH 插件真正需要、却很容易搭错的部分先准备好：

- **bundle 骨架**：兼容性门禁行、宿主服务行、浏览器 client 图锚点行，三行各司其职；
- **host/client 分半构建**：tsdown 产出宿主 ESM 与浏览器闭包工厂，tsc 产出两套声明；
- **兼容性代码契约**：精确版本 allowlist、`unsupported` / `mixed` / `incomplete` 判定、升级车道；
- **完整验证链**：类型检查、lint、单测、组合冒烟、打包门禁、文档检查；
- **工程约定**：AGENTS.md、`.agent/`、`docs/` 九分区、双语 README/CHANGELOG、CI/release/upgrade/diag 工作流。
@dsh-electron/dsh-plugin-scaffold README · 项目简介：脚手架当前只提供**可运行的骨架**：`src/service.ts` 暴露一个占位服务，`src/client/index.ts` 的 `apply` 为空。把这里替换成你的插件行为即可，其余基础设施不需要重搭。

@dsh-electron/dsh-plugin-scaffold README · 环境要求：**作为插件使用者**：一个下表中的 DSH 版本（精确匹配，不是范围）。`dsh plugin` 负责安装，无需本地 Node 工具链。

| DSH 系列 | 受支持的版本 |
| --- | --- |
| `0.2.1` | `0.2.1-rc.2` |

**从源码开发**：Node.js `^22.19.0 || >=24`，pnpm `11.25.0`（建议经 corepack 启用）；开发 pin 的 DSH 为 `0.2.1-rc.2`。

@dsh-electron/dsh-plugin-scaffold README · 快速开始：```sh
git clone https://github.com/cherrchen/dsh-plugin-scaffold.git my-dsh-plugin
cd my-dsh-plugin
export CI=true
pnpm install

`pnpm verify:all` 会依次跑 lint、typecheck、build、test、组合冒烟、打包门禁与打包冒烟。首次运行需要能访问 npm registry。

| --- | --- | --- |
| `package.json` `name` | `@dsh-electron/dsh-plugin-scaffold` | 你的包名 |
| `package.json` `repository.url` | `git+https://github.com/cherrchen/dsh-plugin-scaffold.git` | 你的仓库地址 |
| `LICENSE` 版权行 | `Copyright (c) 2026 Cherry Chen` | 你的名字或组织 |
| 包名引用（源码/脚本/测试） | `@dsh-electron/dsh-plugin-scaffold` | 你的包名 |
| 环境变量 | `DSH_PLUGIN_SCAFFOLD_COMPAT` | `DSH_<YOUR_PLUGIN>_COMPAT` |
| 兼容性服务键 | `dshPluginScaffoldCompat` | 你的服务键 |
| 宿主服务键 | `dshPluginScaffold` | 你的服务键 |
| Connection 通道 | `/dsh-plugin-scaffold` | 你的通道 |
| patch 行 id | `dsh-plugin-scaffold-compat` / `-service` / `-client` | 你的行 id |
| 文档与计划文件名 | 含 `dsh-plugin-scaffold` 的文件 | 你的文档名 |

@dsh-electron/dsh-plugin-scaffold README · 把它变成你的插件：一次定位所有需要改的地方：

```sh
grep -rn "dsh-plugin-scaffold\|dshPluginScaffold\|DSH_PLUGIN_SCAFFOLD" \
  --exclude-dir=node_modules --exclude-dir=.git --exclude-dir=lib .
```

随后按你的插件实际耦合的包，调整 `src/compat/dsh-version.ts` 里的 `REQUIRED_CORE_PACKAGES`、`OPTIONAL_CORE_PACKAGES` 与 `peerDependencies`；`pnpm compat:check` 会在两处漂移时报错。

@dsh-electron/dsh-plugin-scaffold README · 安装与验证组合：安装进 DSH 运行时并检查组合：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add /path/to/repo
dsh --profile web --dump-config | grep -A4 'dsh-plugin-scaffold'
```

预期输出：

```text

@dsh-electron/dsh-plugin-scaffold README · == @dsh-electron/dsh-plugin-scaffold：- id: dsh-plugin-scaffold-compat
  name: '@dsh-electron/dsh-plugin-scaffold/compat'
- id: dsh-plugin-scaffold-service
  name: '@dsh-electron/dsh-plugin-scaffold/service'
- id: dsh-plugin-scaffold-client
  name: '@dsh-electron/dsh-plugin-scaffold'
```

`dsh-plugin-scaffold-compat` 是启动门禁，`dsh-plugin-scaffold-service` 是宿主服务半部（它 inject `dshPluginScaffoldCompat`，门禁不过即不启动），`dsh-plugin-scaffold-client` 挂在裸包名上，是 web 客户端图读取 `dsh.client` 声明的唯一锚点。
